theorem_title: Failure of the normalized mechanical envelope at index fifteen
natural_language_statement:
For $s\in\mathbb N$, define $M(0)=0$, $M(s+1)=3M(s)+2^{\lfloor\log_2(3^s)\rfloor}$, and $e(s)=\lfloor\log_2(3^s)\rfloor+1$.

At the single index $s=15$,

$$
15\cdot3^{15}<4M(15).
$$

Together with the separate theorem for all indices at least 16, this identifies the smallest eventual threshold. This theorem alone states only the failure at 15.
